name: emudevz-sync
description: Edit EmuDevz emulator code in VS Code with live sync to the running game

emudevz.port.markdownDescription: Chrome DevTools Protocol port for connecting to EmuDevz. The game must be launched with `--remote-debugging-port=9222`.

emudevz.autoConnect.description: Automatically connect when VS Code opens

emudevz.syncPaths.description: Paths within the game to show in the file explorer

emudevz.pollInterval.description: Polling interval (ms) for detecting in-game file changes

emudevz.verbose.description: Log all file operations and CDP details to the output channel

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with EmuDevz Sync
walkthroughs.description: Set up live code sync between VS Code and EmuDevz in 3 steps

steps.title: Launch EmuDevz with Debug Port
steps.description:
Add `--remote-debugging-port=9222` to your Steam launch options:

**Steam** → Right-click EmuDevz → Properties → Launch Options

Then launch the game normally.

[Open Steam](command:emudevz.connect)

steps.title: Connect to the Game
steps.description:
Click the button below or use the status bar to connect.

[Connect to EmuDevz](command:emudevz.connect)

steps.title: Edit Your First File
steps.description: Your game files now appear in the Explorer under **EmuDevz Game Files**. Open any file from the `code/` folder and start editing — saves sync to the game instantly!
